def reds(fr):
    L=fr.ascii.split('\n')
    return sorted(set((r//3*3,c//3*3) for r in range(64) for c in range(64) if L[r][c]=='R'))
def ppos(fr):
    L=fr.ascii.split('\n'); pts=[(r,c) for r in range(64) for c in range(64) if L[r][c]=='b']
    return (min(p[0] for p in pts),min(p[1] for p in pts)) if pts else None
moves=['UP','LEFT','UP','LEFT','LEFT','LEFT','DOWN','DOWN','RIGHT']
for mv in moves:
    r=action([mv])
    print(mv,'-> P',ppos(current_frame),'R',reds(current_frame),'res',r.get('board_changed'),r.get('game_over'),r.get('level_completed'),r.get('done'))
    if r.get('game_over') or r.get('done') or r.get('level_completed'): break
</parameter>
</function>
